_note: Evergreen editorial seed pool for bon-voyage, written by Claude on 2026-11-05 for owner review. Tips, ideas, real tools (homepage links only) and generic opportunities. No news: news only comes from the brand's listed feeds. Edit freely.

items.title: Keep one day with no plan
items.summary: Leave a gap for the detour that becomes the story.

items.title: Make a playlist for the long drive
items.summary: Pick songs from every place the road passes.

items.title: Travel a week slower than you planned
items.summary: Fewer stops, longer stays. You remember places you had time to be bored in.

items.title: Learn ten phrases before you land
items.summary: Greetings, thank you and please open more doors than a phrasebook full of grammar.

items.title: Book the first night only
items.summary: Keep the rest loose. Plans made on the ground are often better than plans made at home.

items.title: Plan a trip around one meal
items.summary: Choose a dish, find where it is best, and build the route backwards.

items.title: Take the train for one leg instead of the plane
items.summary: The in-between places are the part of the trip you usually never see.

items.title: Spend a day the way a local would
items.summary: Market in the morning, a café, the library, a walk after dinner.

items.title: Rome2Rio
items.summary: Compare how to get anywhere by train, bus, ferry, car or plane.

items.title: Wikivoyage
items.summary: A free, community-written travel guide to places worldwide.

items.title: TripIt
items.summary: Turn booking emails into one organized itinerary.

items.title: Join a walking tour led by a resident
items.summary: Local guides share what guidebooks skip. Tip them well.

items.title: Trade your home or your time
items.summary: House swaps and volunteer stays can make a long trip affordable.
